outcome: percentage of antibiotic use in inpatient cases
proportion of prophylactic antibiotic application for type I surgical incision
compliance rate of medication administration 0.5-2.0 h before procedures
antibiotic prophylaxis for <=24 h in patients receiving surgeries
cohort: The study investigated antibiotic use data in secondary and tertiary general hospitals in Tianjin, China, from April 2011 to 2013.
finding: Implementation of the Antibiotic Stewardship Program (ASP) significantly reduced irrational antibiotic use, promoted rational antibiotic use, and delayed antibiotic resistance.
